about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the emotional depth of Burden of Command with the official soundtrack. This DLC features over 36 original tracks composed exclusively for the game, blending orchestral and atmospheric styles to reflect the psychological and tactical weight of command during World War II.

Each track was carefully crafted to support the player’s emotional journey, from moments of quiet reflection to the intensity of combat. The music draws from cinematic and historical influences to underscore themes of leadership, sacrifice, and camaraderie.

Included with your purchase:

  • 36 high-quality tracks (MP3)

  • Nearl 1.5 hours of music

  • Music composed specifically for the Burden of Command campaign

This soundtrack is a standalone listening experience for fans of the game, military history, or evocative orchestral music.
